name: git-repo
description: Index the CONTENT of a git repository you own into your knowledge library. Source code AND docs, from a local clone or a github.com URL; each file becomes a searchable knowledge item, and a re-poll after a new commit ingests only the changed files (commit-cursor), never the whole tree. Remote fetches route through the core network chokepoint; it owns no socket.
author: PersonalClaw

x-meta.label: Repository
x-meta.help: The git repository to index: an absolute path to a local working clone on this machine, or an https://github.com/<owner>/<repo> URL. Leave empty to stay idle until set.

x-meta.label: Ref
x-meta.help: The branch, tag, or commit to index. Defaults to HEAD (the repository's current head).

x-meta.label: Include globs
x-meta.help: Comma-separated filename globs to index (e.g. *.py, *.md). Empty means the built-in default, which covers common source-code AND doc extensions.

x-meta.label: Exclude globs
x-meta.help: Comma-separated globs to skip, matched on the path or basename (e.g. *.min.js, tests/*). VCS/dependency/build directories are always skipped.

x-meta.label: Max files
x-meta.help: Hard ceiling on files ingested per poll (1–5000). A huge tree degrades to a bounded ingest rather than a long walk.

x-meta.label: Access token credential
x-meta.help: For a PRIVATE github.com repository: the name of a credential (in Settings > Credentials) holding a personal access token. Sent in an Authorization header, never in a URL. Leave empty for a public repo or a local clone.
